Fishing Manual:
Bring your catch to the Fishing Guild to get useful items in return.
Ugly Fish and Nimble Fish can be exchanged for Fish Stew, a hair accessory, or a Transformation Scroll. Powerful Fish can be exchanged for Elcyum Powder, and you can sell all other fish in a shop.
If you get Elcyum Powder, the Fishing Guild will teach you how to use it. It's up to you to decide what to do with the catch!
